hack.root_cause: Fake Collateral Listing (Social Engineering → On-chain Exploit)
hack.description: Ionic Money lost $6.9M when attackers impersonating the Lombard Finance team convinced the protocol to whitelist a counterfeit LBTC token as collateral, then minted 250 fake tokens, borrowed everything in Ionic's vaults, and vanished through Tornado Cash.
